claims: Sean Miller is the head coach of the Texas Longhorns men's basketball team.
Sean Miller was named to the position on March 24, 2025.
Sean Miller has 20+ years of experience at Arizona and Xavier.
Sean Miller led Texas to the 2026 NCAA Tournament in his first season.
Sean Miller is the 27th Head Coach in Men's Basketball program history.
Sean Miller previously served as head coach at Xavier.
Sean Miller previously served as head coach at Arizona.
Sean Miller has multiple Elite Eight appearances.
Sean Miller led the team to the NCAA Tournament First Four in his debut season during the 2025-26 season.
The Texas Longhorns men's basketball team staff includes assistant coaches Kenya Hunter, Ulric Maligi, and David Miller.
